name: Roof Brief
description: Every number the roof depends on. Unwired inputs keep the defaults, or the values in file.

inputParameters.name: file
inputParameters.description: A brief.json, as the notebook saves it. Optional.

inputParameters.name: beam_depth
inputParameters.description: Depth every beam keeps, mm. Default 500.

inputParameters.name: skin
inputParameters.description: Solid deck over the pores, mm. Default 120.

inputParameters.name: fraction_soffit
inputParameters.description: Solid share at the soffit, 0 to 1. Default 0.42.

inputParameters.name: opening_flare
inputParameters.description: How much wider a light opening is at the faces, mm. Default 260.

inputParameters.name: voxel
inputParameters.description: Sample spacing, mm: 40 to look, 10 to 15 to make. Default 40.

outputParameters.name: brief
outputParameters.description: The brief, for Roof Design and Roof Piece.

outputParameters.name: numbers
outputParameters.description: Every number in the brief, one per line.
